meta.name: dream-video-prompt-generator
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在制作数字人带货短视频时，用本技能一键生成即梦视频中英文提示词。依托四大智能体协同与专属公式，确保人物与情绪高度一致，完美适配5s带货场景，高效产出高质量分镜脚本，让视频制作事半功倍！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入带货主题，生成数字人短视频的中英文分镜提示词
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是电商运营或内容创作者，常做数字人带货短视频却苦于写提示词。
copy.tagline_en: Turn product info into bilingual video prompts for digital-human selling clips.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you create digital-human selling videos and struggle with prompt writing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为「小省导购员」数字人带货视频生成即梦提示词：每幕给出中英文对照版本，涵盖主体、运动、场景、镜头语言、光影、氛围，并附 Suno 音乐与 AI 绘画提示词，同时做一致性与质量核查。
howto.when: 当你需要生成小省导购员数字人带货视频的提示词时触发，例如产品推荐、价格对比等场景；流程会先核查知识库，匹配到同类模板就直接调取。

say.text: 帮我生成5幕产品推荐视频的即梦提示词
say.note: 输出中英文对照的分镜提示词

say.text: 按价格对比场景生成提示词，情绪用客观专业
say.note: 每幕含运动、镜头语言、光影、氛围

say.text: 再给我这几幕的 Suno 音乐和 AI 绘画提示词

howto.what_en: Claude generates Jimeng video prompts for the Xiaosheng shopping-guide digital human. Each 5s scene returns Chinese and English prompts covering subject, movement, scene, shot, light and mood, plus Suno music and AI painting prompts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need prompts for a Xiaosheng shopping-guide digital human video, e.g. product recommendation or price comparison scenes. It first checks the knowledge base and reuses matching templates.

say_en.text: Generate Jimeng prompts for a 5-scene product recommendation video
Make prompts for a price comparison scene, tone objective and professional
say_en.note: Each scene includes movement, shot, light, mood

say_en.text: Also give me the Suno music and AI painting prompts for these scenes
say_en.note: Same source as the Jimeng prompts
